events.line: Holy shit, espn88256878 finally figured out how to read a waiver wire—McMillan absolutely obliterated that projection and saved your sorry ass from another week of getting dunked on in the chat.
espnfan7338848211 really said "nah, I'll ride the bench with my 28-point performance" -- what the fuck were you doing leaving that on the sidelines, you absolute donkey?
kconley5 really said "nah, I don't trust the rookie" and benched Drake fucking Maye for 26 points—congrats on leaving nearly 9 points on your bench like some kind of coward.

Eric, I don't know what the fuck you were smoking when you saw that 16.9 projection, but CeeDee just dropped 41.3 on your ass and frankly you deserve every single point of it for having the balls to actually start him despite everyone's bullshit caution.
82Cole47 really said "nah, I don't need 14 points of free fucking points on my bench" — Romeo Doubs went off for 23.8 and you left him on the shelf like yesterday's sushi, nice move genius.
Kyren Williams just put up 36.7 points and somehow Eric still found a way to be shocked by it—maybe next time don't start a guy you projected for 13 points like he's a handcuff, you fucking coward.

Alvin Kamara just dropped 22.8 points on your bench while you probably started some RBBC backfield committee guy instead—that's what happens when you panic-bench your studs, espnfan7338848211, you absolute donkey.

SteelerFan, you absolute moron—Carnell Tate just dropped 21.5 points on your fucking bench while you started whatever waiver wire trash you thought was safer, and now you get to watch that win slip away because you couldn't trust your own draft pick for one goddamn week.
You benched Brock fucking Purdy and he puts up 19.6 points anyway—what the hell were you thinking, and more importantly, who was your "safer" option that scared you into this disaster?

kconley5 really said "nah, I don't need 19 points this week" and threw RJ Harvey on the bench like he was some waiver-wire scrub—good fucking call leaving damn near 20 points on your bench while your starter probably put up 6.
